verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's own Post-Incident Reviews are documented to help teams "coordinate preventative follow-up actions", and the Scribe Agent records action items from incident calls. That is first-party support for capturing follow-ups, but only as thin, one-line mentions. Missing for 10: evidence that follow-up actions are tracked to completion (status, owners, due dates), documented sync of PIR action items to an issue tracker such as Jira, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
